steps: Pick a learner on the home page
Open section 9.1, set worked problems to none, Start quiz
Reach a fill-in-the-symbols question for a one-sided claim, e.g. 'We want to test the claim that more than 66% of voters support the measure'
Enter H0: = and Ha: > (or H0: = and Ha: < for a 'fewer than' claim), Check answer
expected: Accepted. H0 with '=' is the convention used by the section's own model answers on the same quiz (e.g. open question os-m47033-eip-75 shows 'H0: p = 0.42, Ha: p < 0.42') and by OpenStax, which states only that H0 must contain an equality.
actual: Marked 'Not quite', 'Blanks: H0 ✗ · Ha ✓', correct answer given as H0: ≤ / ≥ only. A learner who follows the model answer shown two questions earlier is graded wrong. Typed ASCII (>=, <=, !=), unicode and button entry all work otherwise.

steps: Pick a learner, open section 6.1, worked problems none, Start quiz
Answer questions 1-3 (check the third but do not press Next)
Press browser reload on the quiz URL
expected: The quiz resumes at question 3 with the three answers kept (partial progress is saved on Quit, so it should survive a reload too).
actual: Intermittent. In one run (qa/e2e/_reopen.mjs) the page came back at 'Question 1 of 10' with a fresh, unanswered question and the learner had to redo the quiz; the run finished with 10 more answers logged. In a second identical run (qa/e2e/_reload.mjs) it correctly restored 'Question 3 of 10' with feedback intact within 25 ms, and a reload on the score screen restored the score screen. Not fully pinned down; reproduce by reloading shortly after checking an answer.

steps: Pick a learner
Open section 1.1 (also 2.5, 8.1, 9.1, 11.2)
Set 'worked problems' to 'none', Start quiz
Go through the 10 questions
expected: No worked problems (open questions with a model answer and self-marking), or a notice that the section does not have 10 instantly-checked questions and the quiz was topped up.
actual: Open/model-answer questions still appear with no notice: 1.1 served 2 of 10, 8.1 2, 9.1 3, 2.5 4, 11.2 4. The URL still says openShare=0. Section 6.1 (24 instant questions) honoured the setting.

steps: Pick a learner, open section 6.1, worked problems none, Start quiz
Reach a numeric question whose stem gives a unit, e.g. 'Values of adult heights follow X ~ N(170, 7) (cm). What value x has a z-score of 1.5?' (answer 180.5)
Type '180.5 cm' (or '180.5cm', or '+180.5'), Check answer
expected: Accepted as 180.5; the stem itself names the unit, and the field already accepts other decorations (fractions, percentages, padding, trailing zeros).
actual: Marked 'Not quite', correct answer 180.5. Accepted forms verified: exact, surrounding spaces, trailing zeros, '1.' , fractions ('2/2', '5.7736/2'), percentages ('100%', '288.68%'), rounding within tolerance ('2.887' for 2.8868). Rejected: trailing unit, leading '+', comma decimal ('2,8868'), scientific notation ('2.89e+0'), 'x = 1'.

steps: Pick a learner, finish any section quiz
On the score screen click 'Retake with new questions'
Look at the address bar
expected: A new quiz gets its own URL (new seed) so that reload, bookmark and 'Print this test' refer to the quiz on screen.
actual: New questions are served (overlap with the previous set 2-6 of 10 across 6.1/9.1/1.1/11.2) and the first question starts with empty inputs, but the URL keeps the previous quiz's seed, e.g. ...&seed=732290 for both quizzes. No screenshot was captured for this one; it is visible in the RETAKE lines of qa/e2e/_twopass.mjs output.

steps: Start a quiz, reach a multiple-choice (or fill-in-the-symbols) question
Without choosing or typing anything click 'Check answer' or press Enter
expected: Either the button is disabled until there is an answer, or a short message says an answer is needed.
actual: Nothing happens at all; no message, button looks enabled. Same for fill-in with both blanks empty.

steps: Pick a learner, answer a multiple-choice question wrongly in a quiz
Open Progress and read the mistake log entry
expected: The entry names the option that was chosen (its text), since choices are shuffled on every quiz.
actual: Entry reads 'your answer: option a · correct: b. variable.' The letter refers to the shuffled order of that one quiz, so it no longer identifies what the learner chose. Noticed while checking Quit; outside the core quiz flow.

steps: Start a 1.1 quiz, answer two questions where the third shares its scenario with the second
Click 'Quit to chapters', then return to the quiz URL (it resumes at question 3); the same happens after a reload that restores the quiz
expected: When the previous question is no longer on screen the scenario is shown in full.
actual: The question shows 'Same scenario as the previous question. Show it again' with no previous question visible. 'Show it again' does reveal the right scenario. When the previous question is on screen the behaviour is fine (verified 3 times in 1.1, scenario text matched).

steps: Answer a fill-in-the-symbols question wrongly, Check answer
expected: Correct answer shown as e.g. 'H0: μ ≤; Ha: μ >' or as the full 'H0: μ ≤ 92'.
actual: Shown as 'Correct answer: H0: μ: ≤; Ha: μ: >' with a doubled colon after the symbol. The explanation line below shows it correctly.
